candidates.name: label_signature_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Aggregating per-label token signatures will give the LLM a compact class-specific prior without needing full-example replay.

candidates.name: recency_window_memory
candidates.hypothesis: A small rolling window of the most recent labeled examples will adapt quickly when task phrasing shifts across batches.

candidates.name: error_driven_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Feeding back only corrected mistakes will focus scarce context on the failure modes most likely to recur.
